backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing user profiles, runbook management, and troubleshooting session workflows with access control enforcement.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report placeholder containing a features array.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file listing summaries of various frontend components and modules for reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme variables and base styles for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point that loads the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes and wraps the app in ThemeProvider with authentication gating.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI screen that displays an access denied message and a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthGate.ts: Authentication wrapper that manages Internet Identity login state and profile setup flow before rendering children.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Sign-in/sign-out button integrating Internet Identity authentication with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog prompting new users to enter and save their name to complete profile setup.
frontend/src/components/history/HistoryF: Filter UI for session history including search, status, and category selectors.
frontend/src/components/intake/CategoryP: Renders a grid of selectable troubleshooting categories using a sprite-based icon system. Calls onChange with the selected category ID.
frontend/src/components/intake/SymptomQu: Displays a list of checkboxes for symptoms based on the chosen category. Updates the selected symptoms through onChange.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Provides the top navigation bar with logo, navigation buttons, and a user profile menu with sign‑out handling. Uses authentication state to conditionally render navigation and profile info.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Wraps pages with a header, main content area, and footer including a caffeine.ai attribution link. Ensures consistent app‑wide layout structure.
frontend/src/components/session/QuickAct: Shows a guided quick action with commands, instructions, and an outcome input. Supports copying commands and submitting the action outcome.
frontend/src/components/session/RunbookS: Displays and manages step‑by‑step runbook execution with outcomes, quick actions, and progress tracking. Handles completing steps and rendering results.
frontend/src/components/session/SessionO: Allows marking a session as resolved or escalating it, and displays a dialog with a copyable escalation summary. Integrates backend mutation hooks and toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on authentication state, reinitializing when identity changes. Invalidates dependent queries when the actor updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and loading stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, sessions, and related actions via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/clipboard.ts: Utility function to copy text to the clipboard using the Clipboard API or a fallback textarea method.
frontend/src/lib/recommendation.ts: Selects the best runbook for a category by scoring symptom similarity against the catalog.
frontend/src/lib/runbooks/catalog.ts: Defines runbook interfaces and exports a catalog of troubleshooting runbooks with steps and quick actions.
frontend/src/lib/sessionFormatting.ts: Formats timestamps into relative time strings or readable dates.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Merges class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/HistoryPage.tsx: Renders the user's session history with filters, search, and session cards.
frontend/src/pages/SessionDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a troubleshooting session including runbook steps and outcome actions.
frontend/src/pages/StartIntakePage.tsx: Implements the issue intake form where users select a category, enter details, answer symptom questions, and start a troubleshooting session.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS with custom colors, typography, container settings, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s metadata, features, requirements, and state version for the IT support app.
